title: tee多分支必需产物全部成功后才原子发布
body:
## 操作任务
交付task.sh INPUT ARCHIVER SUMMARIZER OUTPUT，用GNU tee -p将输入同时送到两个必需消费者。分别等待tee、归档器、摘要器并核对归档字节与输入完全一致；仅所有分支成功且产物齐全时，才在输出目录同文件系统原子发布归档。失败保留旧正式结果及本批临时证据，禁止将tee单一退出状态当成全部消费者成功。

## 提交产物
task.sh

## 验收方法
真实Linux FIFO/tee分流；验证归档失败、摘要器提前关闭、输入读取失败、空流和旧正式文件保留。

## 能力边界
Linux Bash/GNU coreutils；测试只用本地临时文件、FIFO与假消费者，不执行生产采集。摘要器退出状态和摘要文件存在仅代表其自身合同，实际摘要完整性仍由生产摘要器/业务校验提供。
answer:
```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -u
if (( $# != 4 )); then printf 'usage: %s INPUT ARCHIVER SUMMARIZER OUTPUT\n' "$0" >&2; exit 2; fi
input=$1; archiver=$2; summarizer=$3; output=$4
if [[ ! -r "$input" || ! -f "$archiver" || ! -f "$summarizer" || -L "$output" ]]; then printf 'invalid input, worker, or output\n' >&2; exit 2; fi
parent=${output%/*}; [[ $parent == "$output" ]] && parent=.
if [[ ! -d "$parent" ]]; then printf 'output directory missing\n' >&2; exit 2; fi
batch=$(mktemp -d "$parent/.fanout.XXXXXX") || exit 2
archive_fifo=$batch/archive.fifo; summary_fifo=$batch/summary.fifo
archive_tmp=$batch/archive.bin; summary_tmp=$batch/summary.txt
if ! mkfifo "$archive_fifo" "$summary_fifo"; then printf 'cannot create branch FIFOs\n' >&2; exit 2; fi
"$BASH" "$archiver" "$archive_tmp" <"$archive_fifo" & archive_pid=$!
"$BASH" "$summarizer" "$summary_tmp" <"$summary_fifo" & summary_pid=$!
tee -p "$archive_fifo" "$summary_fifo" <"$input" >/dev/null; tee_status=$?
wait "$archive_pid"; archive_status=$?
wait "$summary_pid"; summary_status=$?
expected_bytes=$(LC_ALL=C wc -c < "$input"); expected_bytes=${expected_bytes//[[:space:]]/}
summary_bytes=$(cat -- "$summary_tmp" 2>/dev/null || true)
if [[ ! $expected_bytes =~ ^[0-9]+$ || ! $summary_bytes =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || (( expected_bytes != summary_bytes )); then summary_status=1; fi
if (( tee_status != 0 || archive_status != 0 || summary_status != 0 )) || [[ ! -f "$archive_tmp" || ! -f "$summary_tmp" ]] || ! cmp -s -- "$input" "$archive_tmp"; then
    printf 'FANOUT_FAILED tee=%s archive=%s summary=%s batch=%s\n' "$tee_status" "$archive_status" "$summary_status" "$batch" >&2
    exit 1
fi
if ! mv -f -- "$archive_tmp" "$output"; then printf 'PUBLISH_FAILED batch=%s\n' "$batch" >&2; exit 1; fi
rm -f -- "$archive_fifo" "$summary_fifo" "$summary_tmp"
rmdir -- "$batch"
printf 'PUBLISHED\n'; exit 0
```

原题知识说明：
交付分支依赖清单，明确归档与摘要都是必需结果还是某支仅尽力而为；为每支保存PID、退出状态和字节或记录对账。单看tee退出码或最外层pipefail不足以覆盖进程替代中的所有消费者，必须独立等待并核验各分支，特别是消费者提前关管道和落盘失败。GNU tee的输出错误策略应按管道与普通文件分别确认，不把忽略破管道选项当通用容错。验收故意让摘要器提前退出、归档盘满、输入源读错以及空流，成功门禁要求输入完整且全部必需分支产物已验证。任何失败保留临时产物和分支状态，禁止移动到正式发布路径；重跑使用新批次并明确是否覆盖旧的完整结果，防止摘要正常掩盖归档丢失。
review_note: 现有ID改编；完成情况按精确题目、执行bundle及原生五路证据核对，不以脚本生成认定完成。
rubric: 解释题设特有机制及前提
给出可核验的证据、成功与失败判据
界定异常恢复与不可承诺的边界

test_files.checks/check.py:
import sys,pathlib,tempfile,os,subprocess
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True);print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED: tee required-branch publication gate',flush=True)
if 'NotImplementedError' in pathlib.Path('task.sh').read_text(encoding='utf8'):raise NotImplementedError('implement task.sh')
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='tee-fanout-') as directory:
 root=pathlib.Path(directory);input_path=root/'capture.bin';archive=root/'archive.bin';script=root/'task.sh';archiver=root/'archive.sh';summarizer=root/'summary.sh'
 script.write_text(pathlib.Path('task.sh').read_text(encoding='utf8'));archiver.write_text(pathlib.Path('archiver.sh').read_text(encoding='utf8'));summarizer.write_text(pathlib.Path('summarizer.sh').read_text(encoding='utf8'))
 old=b'previous complete archive';archive.write_bytes(old);input_path.write_bytes((b'packet\x00data\n'*150000))
 env=os.environ.copy()
 def run(source=input_path,archive_mode='ok',summary_mode='ok'):
  current=env.copy();current['ARCHIVE_MODE']=archive_mode;current['SUMMARY_MODE']=summary_mode
  return subprocess.run(['/bin/bash',str(script),str(source),str(archiver),str(summarizer),str(archive)],env=current,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=8)
 good=run();assert good.returncode==0 and 'PUBLISHED' in good.stdout and archive.read_bytes()==input_path.read_bytes()
 archive.write_bytes(old);failed=run(archive_mode='fail');assert failed.returncode==1 and 'FANOUT_FAILED' in failed.stderr and archive.read_bytes()==old
 archive.write_bytes(old);early=run(summary_mode='early');assert early.returncode==1 and 'FANOUT_FAILED' in early.stderr and archive.read_bytes()==old,(early.returncode,early.stdout,early.stderr,archive.read_bytes()[:80])
 archive.write_bytes(old);missing=run(root/'missing');assert missing.returncode==2 and archive.read_bytes()==old
 empty=root/'empty';empty.write_bytes(b'');empty_result=run(empty);assert empty_result.returncode==0 and archive.read_bytes()==b''
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
